dct_description_sm: **For real-time data downloads, go to [LogIE Ukraine operation page](https://logie.logcluster.org/?op=ukr-22-a)** This dataset contains layers ESRI ArcGIS Online feature services for the following layers of interest to the logistics cluster in Ukraine: - Entry and exit points - Ports - Supply routes - Roads - Railways - Reception points - Roads in Poland
